title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & parallelism
author: Alexandra Kim
description:
Motivation: our repository has accumulated multiple overlapping GitHub Actions workflows for linting, unit/integration tests, and release automation. This causes duplicated setup steps, inconsistent caching behavior, and long CI queues during peak development. This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows into a smaller set of shared workflows, normalizes action versions, improves cache keys and parallelism settings, and adds incremental pipeline hygiene to reduce CI time and failure flakiness.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces .github/workflows/ci.yml that combines linting and test orchestration with job matrices and reusable job templates.
- Replaces separate lint and test workflows with a single entrypoint that uses reusable jobs for node install, tooling cache priming, and workspace setup.
- Centralizes release automation into .github/workflows/release.yml and removes duplicated publish steps from other jobs.
- Standardizes GitHub Action versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4) across workflows; bumps node matrix to node 20 where appropriate.
- Improves cache key strategy: include OS, node-version, yarn-version, and lockfile checksum; use restore-keys fallback order to better hit cache in split-matrix runs.
- Adds parallelism controls and smart concurrency groups to limit duplicate runs for frequent branch pushes and reduce queue pressure.
- Removes deprecated workflow files and migrates small tooling scripts into scripts/ci folder for reuse.

Checklist: 
- [x] Consolidate workflows and migrate callers
- [x] Update action versions and node matrix
- [x] Add improved cache keys and restore-keys
- [x] Add concurrency groups and limit parallel runs
- [x] Run full CI in a feature branch and iterate on failures
- [x] Add release notes and update internal docs

Testing and verification:
- Ran full CI matrix on feature branch (node 18 & 20, ubuntu-latest, macos-latest sample) — all checks completed successfully after two minor iteration commits.
- Verified cache hit/miss rates on subsequent runs: improved average cache hit probability from ~42% to ~71% across yarn install steps in sample runs.
- Verified release automation dry-run on the release workflow and validated tag creation logic in a staging repo.

Backward compatibility / migration notes:
- Existing tooling that referenced the old workflow filenames will be updated by this PR (links in README and internal runbooks updated).
- No code changes to library packages – only CI config changes.

Follow-ups:
- ENG-9001: evaluate further parallelism reductions for nightly integration matrix.
- ENG-9250: add dependency cache layer for prebuilt wheel artifacts used by integration tests.

Files changed (high level): .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml, .github/workflows/legacy-lint.yml (deleted), .github/workflows/legacy-test.yml (deleted), scripts/ci/setup.sh (new), scripts/ci/cache-utils.sh (new), .github/contrib/README-CI.md (updated), package.json (ci scripts updated)
